symbols.name: Settings

files.note: The Telegram connection: receives messages, buttons and files, sends replies (text, charts, CSV), publishes the bot profile. Polling or webhook.

symbols.name: split_message

symbols.name: to_plain

symbols.name: keyboard
symbols.doc: Turn button rows (ui.Btn) into a Telegram inline keyboard.

symbols.name: deliver

symbols.name: on_callback

symbols.name: start

symbols.name: stop

symbols.name: telegram_webhook
symbols.doc: Telegram webhook.

files.note: The screens: stats, charts, balance, history, budgets, savings plan, undo, export, dashboard link.

files.note: Plain-message reader built from rules, no AI: amounts, dates, accounts, categories, several items per message, questions, savings goals.

symbols.name: Context

files.note: The LangGraph agent: remembers pending confirmations, picks tools, writes replies, falls back to rules when the AI fails.

symbols.name: confirmation_node

symbols.name: tool_executor_node
symbols.doc: Node 3: Executes MCP tools dynamically.

symbols.name: response_synthesizer_node

symbols.name: route_after_llm_reasoning

symbols.name: process_message

files.note: The multi-step loop for goals and questions: AI picks tools, we run them, AI answers. Capped steps, safe tool list.

symbols.doc: Cheap check: is this a question or goal rather than a plain 'spent 200 on tea'?

symbols.name: Result
symbols.doc: What the loop produced.

symbols.name: run
symbols.doc: Run the loop. Raises on AI failure only if nothing was changed yet (caller falls back).

files.note: The ONLY code that changes balances: record expense/income, transfer, undo, history. Validates every amount.

symbols.name: parse_when
symbols.doc: Accepts a datetime, an ISO date/datetime string, or None. Raises LedgerError if unreadable.

symbols.name: LedgerError
symbols.doc: Invalid ledger operation (bad amount or type, same-account transfer).

symbols.name: validate_amount
symbols.doc: Returns the amount rounded to 2 decimals, or raises LedgerError (0, negative, NaN, inf).

symbols.name: get_or_create_user
symbols.doc: Retrieves an existing user by Telegram chat ID or creates a new one.

symbols.name: get_or_create_account
symbols.doc: Finds an account by name (case-insensitive) or creates it.

symbols.name: get_or_create_category
symbols.doc: Finds a category by name or creates it.

symbols.name: get_or_create_merchant
symbols.doc: Finds a merchant by name or creates it.

symbols.name: record_transaction
symbols.doc: Logs an expense or income and updates the corresponding account balance atomically.

symbols.name: transfer_between_pipes
symbols.doc: Transfers funds from Pipe A to Pipe B without logging an external expense.

symbols.name: get_account_balances
symbols.doc: Fetches balances for all accounts associated with user and calculates net balance.

symbols.name: get_spending_summary
symbols.doc: Aggregates recent spending by category and merchant.

symbols.name: undo_transaction
symbols.doc: Delete one of the user's transactions and put the balances back as they were.

symbols.name: recent_transactions
symbols.doc: Newest first, with human-readable names. Returns (rows, total count).

files.note: All the numbers: periods and filters, breakdowns, trends, budgets, projections, savings plan, insights.

symbols.name: Query
symbols.doc: What to analyse: a time window plus optional filters.

symbols.name: parse_period
symbols.doc: Turn '30d', '6m', '1y', 'mtd', 'last month', '2025-09', 'ytd', 'all' or 'A..B' into a Query.

symbols.name: resolve_filters
symbols.doc: Match leftover words ('food', 'hdfc', 'swiggy') to this user's categories/accounts/merchants.

symbols.name: load_rows
symbols.doc: All transactions in the window that pass the filters, oldest first (one SQL query).

symbols.name: category_breakdown
symbols.doc: Spending per category (top N, the rest folded into 'Other'), with share and change.

symbols.name: series
symbols.doc: Spending and income per day/week/month (empty buckets included), with a trailing average.

symbols.name: hour_pattern
symbols.doc: Spending by hour of day. None if almost all times are midnight (imported statements).

symbols.name: calendar_heatmap
symbols.doc: Spend per day for the last N weeks, laid out Monday..Sunday per column.

symbols.name: size_distribution
symbols.doc: How many expenses fall into each size band.

symbols.name: category_by_period
symbols.doc: Stacked-chart data: for each period, spend per top category (+ Other).

symbols.name: recurring
symbols.doc: Merchants charged repeatedly for a near-constant amount (subscriptions, rent, bills).

symbols.name: unusual
symbols.doc: Expenses at least 3x the usual size for their category (and over 500).

symbols.name: net_worth_series
symbols.doc: Total money over time, rebuilt by walking back from today's balances.

symbols.name: budget_status
symbols.doc: Each category with a monthly budget: spent so far this month and what is left.

symbols.name: month_pace
symbols.doc: This month's cumulative spend against last month's, plus a projection to month end.

symbols.name: insights
symbols.doc: A few short, plain sentences worth telling the user (empty list if no data).

symbols.name: report
symbols.doc: Everything the dashboard, chat messages and chart images need, for one query.

symbols.name: savings_plan
symbols.doc: Can the user save `target` rupees in `months` months, and where could the money come from?

symbols.doc: Base error raised by the gateway.

symbols.name: NoAPIKeyError

symbols.doc: Every candidate key/provider failed with a retryable error.

symbols.name: replace_api_key

symbols.name: get_plain_key

symbols.name: AIGateway

symbols.doc: LiteLLM model name (``provider/id``) discovered for this key, or None to use the default.

symbols.name: rank_models
symbols.doc: Up to ~5 chat models in the order worth trying (the first that answers is used).

symbols.name: model_chain
symbols.doc: LiteLLM names (``provider/id``) to try for this key: the one that last worked, then the ranking.

files.note: The 8 tables. Marks which columns are encrypted.
Encryption: HKDF-derived keys, Fernet, `enc1:` format, key rotation, the encrypted column type.

symbols.name: all_secrets
symbols.doc: SECRET_KEY first, then every SECRET_KEY_OLD entry (duplicates and blanks removed).

symbols.name: weak_secret_key
symbols.doc: True if SECRET_KEY is a public placeholder or too short to be a real random secret.

symbols.name: derive_key
symbols.doc: A Fernet key for one purpose (``context``) derived from one secret with HKDF-SHA256.

symbols.name: multi_fernet
symbols.doc: Encrypts with the newest secret, decrypts with any of them.

symbols.name: newest_fernet
symbols.doc: Only the newest secret. Used to tell whether a value still needs rotating.

symbols.name: decrypt_text_strict
symbols.doc: Like ``decrypt_text`` but raises ``InvalidToken`` when no configured key works.

symbols.name: decrypt_text
symbols.doc: Plaintext for an ``enc1:`` value; legacy plaintext is returned unchanged.

symbols.name: needs_rotation
symbols.doc: True for an ``enc1:`` value that the newest key cannot read (written with an older one).

symbols.name: rotate_text
symbols.doc: Re-encrypt an ``enc1:`` value with the newest key. Raises ``InvalidToken`` if unreadable.

symbols.name: EncryptedText
symbols.doc: A Text column that is encrypted in the database and plaintext in Python.

symbols.name: legacy_vault_fernet
symbols.doc: The original vault cipher, ``Fernet(sha256(SECRET_KEY))``. Read-only fallback.

symbols.name: decrypt_vault
symbols.doc: New HKDF format first, then the legacy sha256 format. Raises ``InvalidToken``.

symbols.name: vault_needs_rotation
symbols.doc: True if the newest vault key cannot read ``token`` (older secret or legacy format).

tours.title: A message becomes a transaction
tours.ask: You send: Spent 200 on chai, 80 on auto yesterday

steps.text: Telegram delivers the message to the bot.
`handle_incoming` checks you are allowed, and that it is not a /command or a screen.
The agent runs. First it asks the rules to read the message.
Rules find 2 items, the amounts, the category words and the date. No AI is used.
Each item becomes a tool call: `log_expense`.
The ledger validates and saves the transaction and updates the balance together.
A two-line reply is written, and an Undo button is attached.

tours.title: A question for the AI
tours.ask: You send: Can I afford a 50000 laptop in 5 months?

steps.text: Not a command, not a screen: it goes to the agent.
Rules see a question, so nothing is logged.
The multi-step helper starts (needs an AI key).
Picks your key (then shared, then server keys) and the best model.
The AI calls `savings_plan` / `get_financial_snapshot`.
Real numbers from your last 90 days come back.
The AI reads them and writes a short answer.
Builds a private link, valid for 2 hours.
Signs the link (chat id + expiry) so it cannot be forged.
Checks the signature, serves the page and the data.
Computes the same numbers the Telegram charts use.
The browser draws 12 charts from that data.
Downloads the file (size and type checked).
Starts the import flow and shows a preview.
Detects the format, reads rows with the statement's own dates, guesses categories.
You tap Import: rows already in the ledger are skipped.
Each new row is saved with its real date.
Finds the provider from the key's shape.
Tests the key live with a real model. Only a working key is saved.
The key is encrypted with its own derived key.
Stored in `api_keys.encrypted_key`.
Your message is deleted from the chat.
